name: ITM
verdict: New Zealand building-supplies co-operative owned by its member stores, more than 90 of them. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: Official Partner of the Black Foils and title partner of the ITM New Zealand Sail Grand Prix since 2022 (SailGP press release, 7 Dec 2022; team page fetched 2026-09-30). The co-operative's shares are held by its member stores' companies (Companies Register, largest parcel 8.20%); no state or state fund among them, and no court, regulator, UN-body or major-NGO human-rights finding against the co-operative found.
